location_context: Bay of Bengal Near the Eastern Coast of India
detailed_description: Satellite-style geographic imagery showing a large section of the Bay of Bengal and the eastern coastline of India. The dominant feature is the open ocean, with the coastal landmass visible along the right and lower-right portions of the image. Major coastal and inland locations visible in the scene include Visakhapatnam, Kakinada, Vijayawada, Nellore, and Tirupati. The image provides a broad regional view rather than a detailed land-use scene.
